commentary.text: 90+6' Alejandro Ruiz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Koke (Atl. Madrid) for his blatant foul.
90+1' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) swings in a cross from the corner, but Unai Simon reads it well and gathers the ball.

90+1' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
88' The Atl. Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

85' 1 - 0 It's in! Nico Williams spots his teammate in a good position on the edge of the box and provides him with a nice pass. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) doesn't think twice and rifles a first-time shot into the right side of the goal. The score is now 1:0.
82' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Oihan Sancet and he is replaced by Izeta (Ath Bilbao).
82' Jesus Areso goes off the pitch and Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) comes on.

81' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
80' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) brings an opponent down and Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game.
80' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find Nico Williams with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
79' Half-chance! Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) plays a pass into the box, but Jan Oblak reacts well to snuff out the attack.

77' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Jan Oblak leaps like a salmon to deny him.
76' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner with a short pass.
76' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.

76' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
75' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) brings his opponent down. Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Some patient build-up play from Atl. Madrid as they look to unlock the defence.
72' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Gonzalez will be replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid).

72' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.

72' A sweet pass finds Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Unai Simon is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
71' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
71' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
69' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
69' The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
68' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
66' Here is a change. Gorka Guruzeta is going off and Ernesto Valverde gives the last tactical orders to Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
66' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta walks off the pitch to be replaced by Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao).
66' Substitution. Julian Alvarez will be replaced by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
64' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
62' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) replacing Clement Lenglet.
62' The game has come to an end for Thiago Almada. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
61' The ball is cleared after Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
58' The Ath Bilbao players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
55' Close! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
55' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
53' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
51' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.
50' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
49' Atl. Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
48' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is caught offside!
46' Substitution. Koke (Atl. Madrid) replaces Conor Gallagher.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
45+2' The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
43' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Jan Oblak is prepared to thwart his effort.

41' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
41' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Ruiz signals a set piece.
40' A short pass finds Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
38' A pass by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid will have a throw-in.
37' One of the players from Atl. Madrid times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
36' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.

35' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Ruiz with no other option than to blow for a foul.
33' Ernesto Valverde is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Aymeric Laporte suffers an injury and Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
31' Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) picks up an injury.
30' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to find Alex Berenguer, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
28' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
26' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) plays a through ball but overhits it.
26' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
24' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

22' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
21' Ath Bilbao take a short corner kick.
20' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Ruiz had an easy-decision to make.
20' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) serves up a nice cross, but Jan Oblak punches the ball away.
18' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

18' What an opportunity! Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes low towards the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
17' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley high over the bar.
17' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
14' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Ruiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
14' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

14' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ath Bilbao.
12' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
11' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
10' Ath Bilbao keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
8' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
7' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
6' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
4' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Ruiz stops the game and makes a call.
4' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
3' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
2' A dangerous looking corner kick from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is cleared to safety by the defence.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Atl. Madrid will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Alejandro Ruiz.
